channel.title: Tanzania - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Tanzania, every source cited.

item.title: Tanzania and Russia explore new trade and investment opportunities
item.description: Engineer Mashauri Jofrey Sabwoya highlights potential for economic and technological cooperation following recent high-level visits.

item.title: Tanzania mourns historian John Iliffe
item.description: Professor John Iliffe, who died on August 20, 2026, significantly shaped Tanzanian history studies.

item.title: Tanzania opens new government city in Dodoma
item.description: President Samia Suluhu Hassan inaugurated the Mtumba Government City, a project costing Sh700 billion.

item.title: Kenyan court orders police to produce missing Tanzanian activist
item.description: Justice Alexander Muasya Muteti ordered police to present Twaha Mwaipaya in court on November 2, 2026, with a detention warrant.

item.title: Tanzania election victims await justice one year on
item.description: Thousands may have died in protests after the October 29 election, with many victims still traumatised and seeking redress.
